name: context-gauge
description: Keeps a status line under the prompt with the context size, a warning icon past two thresholds, the time left on the prompt cache and the session's age.

warnTokens.title: Warning threshold (tokens)
warnTokens.description: Context size that turns the icon to a warning. 0 = 150k, capped at 60% of the model's window.

critTokens.title: Critical threshold (tokens)
critTokens.description: Context size that turns the icon to a stop sign. 0 = 400k, capped at 80% of the model's window.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: Counted from the end of the last main-thread turn. 60 on a subscription, 5 on an API key. 0 hides the countdown.
